text:
maria: Quick heads-up — procurement moved our EU H100 shipment by ~7 days. This hits two reserved slots for Dedicated P1 this sprint. Need to stitch milestones and owners.
kevin: Ugh. Which slots specifically? Can we swap with a different rack or use partial capacity?
maria: Slot IDs RU-14 and RU-15. Vendor says earliest arrival is now 2024-03-05 ETA.
olivia: We can backfill RU-14 with RU-22 (same region) but RU-15 needs a driver card that only H100s provide.
sam: If RU-15 is blocked, what's the customer impact? Any SLA at risk?
maria: Affecting one Dedicated customer scheduled for capacity on 03/04. SLA won't breach immediately, but throughput targets for their ingest path will be degraded ~20% unless we provide a temporary fallback model.
tia: Could we route that tenant to a lower-capacity pool + autoscale buffer? What's the latency hit?
kevin: Lower-cap model (A30-quant) shows +30ms p99 in our perf sims, and ~1.8x token cost. Customer willing to accept if we flag it. Need sign-off.
olivia: I'll open a small canary on A30-quant in eu-west-1, capacity=2 slots for 48h. If perf looks ok, promote.
maria: Thanks. Can someone own the customer comms? I can draft, but want product/legal sign-off.
sam: I can pair with you. I'll ping product and legal.
kevin: Also ping infra to flip reservation mapping — PR incoming: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/+/2345 Change: map RU-22 -> RU-14 backfill.
kevin: @olivia can you review that PR? small change to allocation map.
olivia: On it, will review in next hour.
kevin: Also opening a ticket to re-evaluate the rollout milestone: TICKET-4872. Owners: infra (kevin), runtime (olivia), customer-sre (sam).
maria: Action items pinned: 1) infra PR to remap RU-22 (kevin) 2) canary A30-quant + telemetry (olivia) 3) customer comms draft (maria + sam) 4) fallback routing policy update (tia) 5) rebook procurement ETA tracking (maria).
tia: For fallback routing, I suggest adding a temporary priority rule: route tenant -> A30-quant if H100 capacity missing for >6h. Will open small change to routing rules: https://git.internal/r/redwood/routing/+/678
sam: Customer comms draft: "We expect a short delay to full throughput; temporary routing to alternate nodes may be used. No data access changes. ETA update by 2024-03-05." Will share soon.
olivia: Canary config snippet: ```yaml
canary:
  region: eu-west-1
  model: a30-quant:2024-01
  capacity: 2
  duration: 48h
  telemetry: token_latency,p99,errors
```
kevin: FYI ops schedule: we have a maintenance window on 2024-03-02 03:00-05:00 UTC; don't schedule the promote during that window.
maria: Noted.
 deploy-bot: scheduled deploy for routing change queued by tia at 2024-02-27T16:42:00Z — CI passed :white_check_mark:
kevin: Once PR merged, I'll update reservation registry and send a short note to partners.
maria: Olivia, can you post canary results as a short table in this thread when ready? Even summary lines are fine.
olivia: Will do. ETA for canary metrics ~6h after start.
sam: tagging @customer-success to prep the account note.
tia: I'll draft the routing rule change and include the 6h threshold+rollback.
maria: Thanks all. If anyone needs handoff, ping me. We'll reconvene async — if legal/product hold, sam pls escalate. :thumbsup:
